recognize_zh: 骨髓切片造血組織中有一個星芒狀、棕色的分生孢子頭：中央囊泡周圍放射狀瓶梗並散布棕黑色分生孢子，右上角還有另一個，周邊亦見菌絲斷片，是麴菌（Aspergillus）侵犯骨髓的表現。
features: Stellate, brown-pigmented conidial head with a central vesicle and radiating phialides within marrow
A second, less distinct pigmented fruiting structure in the upper right field
Scattered dark brown round conidia among hematopoietic cells
Bluish-purple filamentous hyphal fragments near a megakaryocyte
Cellular marrow with fat spaces, bone trabecula at top, megakaryocytes; no obvious necrosis
describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow section shows cellular marrow with fat spaces and a bony trabecula, within which lie a stellate, brown-pigmented conidial head with radiating phialides and a second similar structure, together with scattered brown conidia. Faint bluish filamentous structures consistent with hyphal fragments are present nearby. Megakaryocytes and trilineage hematopoiesis are present, and necrosis or granulomatous inflammation is not evident. Findings are consistent with Aspergillus involvement of the bone marrow; confirmation with GMS/PAS stains and culture, and exclusion of contamination given the rarity of conidiation in deep tissue, are recommended.

ddx.vs: Mucorales show broad pauciseptate ribbon-like hyphae and do not form phialide-bearing conidial heads.
Contaminants typically lie on or outside tissue without hyphae or host reaction, whereas invasive disease shows hyphae within marrow.
Hemosiderin forms irregular golden-brown granules without organized radiating phialides and is Prussian blue positive.
